rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy has completed more than three comparable reference projects within the last five years, including the LVI-ylläpito framework for Keski-Vaaran kaupunki's own school properties (REF05) and the kiinteistönhoito and LVI framework for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (REF02).
Visakoivu Oy's turnover in its most recent financial year (2025) was EUR 20,300,000, above the required minimum for this contract.
Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio in its most recent financial statements was 35.2%, above the required minimum for this contract.

Visakoivu Oy will operate an annual visit calendar for each school property covered by this agreement, with a standard task list for each visit and a signed visit report issued to the contracting authority confirming completion of the tasks carried out.

Visakoivu Oy will include a preventive maintenance plan covering the HVAC, electrical and kitchen refrigeration systems at each school property, scheduled around manufacturer-recommended service intervals.

Visakoivu Oy maintains stock of common spare parts for the installed building systems through its regional supplier network; parts not held in stock are sourced with a standard delivery time of five working days, or sooner where the fault affects a safety-critical system.

Visakoivu Oy will maintain an asset register for the systems covered by this agreement and hand it over, together with supporting documentation, to the contracting authority at the start of the contract, as received, and again at the end of the contract, updated to reflect the term of the agreement.

Visakoivu Oy proposes to monitor energy consumption trends across the properties during routine visits and to recommend efficiency measures such as optimised HVAC scheduling and control-system tuning where opportunities are identified.

Visakoivu Oy operates a standby (paivystys) arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays, staffed by on-call technicians from its LVI, electrical and refrigeration teams; fault reports are acknowledged promptly and prioritised by category.

Following any repair or installation work, Visakoivu Oy carries out a commissioning and functional test of the affected system, records the test results, and confirms to the contracting authority that the system is operating correctly before closing out the work order.

Visakoivu Oy holds electrical contracting rights (Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1) and arranges the periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations at each property in accordance with the applicable inspection intervals, using its own qualified electrical personnel.

Visakoivu Oy will provide a method statement for the installation work covered by this agreement, describing the sequence of works, safety controls and testing steps to be followed for each type of installation.
Visakoivu Oy is prepared to discuss a volume-based discount structure on the framework agreement's overall value at the time of contract finalisation.
Visakoivu Oy proposes standard payment terms of 21 days net from the date of a correctly issued invoice.
Visakoivu Oy is open to agreeing a bonus/malus arrangement linked to the service levels in Section 4, to be defined jointly with the contracting authority during contract finalisation.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a limitation of liability capped at the contract's annual value, in line with its liability and professional indemnity insurance cover, excluding wilful misconduct or gross negligence.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose CVs of the key personnel proposed for delivery of this contract, drawn from its LVI, electrical and property maintenance teams.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a certificate confirming payment of its taxes.
This tender document uses a minimum font size of 11pt throughout.
All monetary figures in this tender are rounded to two decimal places.
This tender's cover page is marked with the submission deadline of 19.10.2026, 12:00 (EET), stating both the time zone and the exact time.
This tender is drafted in Finnish, as required.

Visakoivu Oy requires personnel working on school premises, including subcontracted staff, to hold the occupational safety card (tyoturvallisuuskortti), to undergo any child-safeguarding briefing required for work on school premises, and to hold the trade-specific certificates relevant to their discipline.

Visakoivu Oy will provide training to the contracting authority's own property staff on the operation of the systems maintained under this agreement, covering routine checks, fault reporting, and basic troubleshooting appropriate to non-specialist staff.

Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual visual inspection of the roof, facade and windows at each school property, supplemented by a more detailed condition survey every three years, with findings recorded in the same visit-reporting system described in the response to Section 4.1.

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid qualification under the F-Gas Regulation (F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen patevyys) and maintains the refrigeration equipment in school kitchens under a scheduled inspection regime consistent with that qualification, including leak checks at the intervals required by the regulation.
Visakoivu Oy accepts the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a certificate from its pension insurance provider confirming that its pension insurance payments (elakevakuutusmaksut) are up to date.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and submit the Tender Form provided as Liite 1.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender in response to Keski-Vaaran kaupunki's invitation to tender for the framework agreement for technical maintenance of school properties (KVK-TEK-2026/11).
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a Jyvaskyla-based technical and property services company founded in 1994, providing LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance services to public and private clients across Central Finland.
